description: Information Extraction agent: turns free-text NovaBank support tickets into a structured, queryable table (one row per ticket).

source.note: issue_description is plain string text (resolution-style notes). If your source were PDFs/images in a Unity Catalog Volume, run ai_parse_document() first to produce this text column.

global_instructions: Extract only what the text supports. If a field is not stated or implied, return null (or the 'not_applicable'/'none'/'unknown' value where the schema defines one).
Never invent merchants, amounts, or IDs.
Normalise every value to the allowed set for its field; do not return free text for enum fields.
Set customer_sentiment to 'neutral' unless the text contains explicit emotional language (e.g. 'furious', 'very happy').
follow_up_required is true only when the note implies further customer or bank action is still pending (e.g. a chargeback under review, or the customer must make a payment).

fields.name: issue_category
fields.description: The primary reason the customer contacted support, inferred from the description.

fields.name: product
fields.description: The banking product the ticket concerns. Card declines, fraud, and disputes are credit_card; login issues are mobile_banking.

fields.name: merchant
fields.description: The merchant named in the ticket (e.g. 'Amazon India', 'Swiggy', 'IRCTC', 'Croma', 'MakeMyTrip', 'Flipkart'). Return null if no merchant is mentioned.

fields.name: root_cause
fields.description: The underlying cause described. 'credit_limit_reached' is the flagship case (mirrors the INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT_LIMIT decline on transaction TXN00000010).

fields.name: resolution_action
fields.description: The action support took or advised, as stated in the note.

fields.name: follow_up_required
fields.description: Whether further action is still pending after this note. See global instructions.

fields.name: customer_sentiment
fields.description: Customer emotional tone. Default to 'neutral' unless the text is explicitly emotional.
